How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Tech or M.Tech degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering and must be GATE/NET qualified.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email with all required documents and bio-data before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee).

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this JRF position?
faq.answer: The JRF position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.
